description.en: Read DSH replies aloud with Microsoft neural voices (Xiaoxiao, Yunxi, …) through a local edge-tts service: read the selection, read from here to the end, or read the whole reply, with voice and speed switching and same-origin streaming playback. Open the panel by selecting text or pressing Shift + right-click; rules, arrows, emoji and other unreadable characters are skipped, and browser speech covers an unavailable service.
description.zh: 用微软神经网络语音（晓晓、云希等）朗读 DSH 的回复：选中文字或按 Shift+右键呼出面板，可朗读选中 / 从当前读到结尾 / 整条回复，支持切换音色与语速、同源流式播放；图表线条、箭头、emoji 等读不出来的字符自动跳过，服务不可用时退回浏览器语音。
